title: One More Window
description: Original fictional fable. Illustrated through a montage of permitted historical paintings, not a biography of the artist or a historical event.
hook: The boy asked his grandfather to paint him a window.
payoff: 'You. When I get out, who is showing me the way?'

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The boy asked his grandfather to paint him a window.
units.onscreen: The boy asked his grandfather to paint him a window.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: There was already one above his bed. It faced a brick wall.
units.onscreen: There was already one above his bed. It faced a brick wall.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The old man had painted houses all his life. Gardens were harder.
units.onscreen: The old man had painted houses all his life. Gardens were harder.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: But on Tuesday, a garden appeared beside the bed.
units.onscreen: But on Tuesday, a garden appeared beside the bed.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: On Wednesday, the boy asked for a road. 'Where should it go?'
units.onscreen: On Wednesday, the boy asked for a road. 'Where should it go?'

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: 'Somewhere we can walk when I am better.'
units.onscreen: 'Somewhere we can walk when I am better.'

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: So his grandfather added a cafe at the far end, with two chairs outside.
units.onscreen: So his grandfather added a cafe at the far end, with two chairs outside.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: The old man sold the one picture he had always refused to sell.
units.onscreen: The old man sold the one picture he had always refused to sell.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: When he returned, the boy was standing, leaning on a chair.
units.onscreen: When he returned, the boy was standing, leaning on a chair.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: 'You have forgotten someone,' he said. 'Who?' asked his grandfather.
units.onscreen: 'You have forgotten someone,' he said. 'Who?' asked his grandfather.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: 'You. When I get out, who is showing me the way?'
units.onscreen: 'You. When I get out, who is showing me the way?'
